title: Space
description: A native GPU star field over four translucent layers of drifting cosmic clouds.
notes: Original GPU implementation, not redistributed Canvas source. Preserves the seven controls and layered-cloud/outward-star composition. Stable procedural seeds replace JavaScript randomness; star lifetimes and cloud oscillations use integrated animation speed at a normalized 60 Hz reference. Cloud speed response is continuous and linear instead of the original wall-clock-dependent curve. A zero animation speed freezes motion while live color/size controls remain usable. Particle placement, startup population and antialiasing differ; pixel identity is not claimed.
